name: 黑色粗跟切尔西短靴款
description: 黑白撞色弹力侧带与稳定粗跟的极简切尔西短靴详情套图，杂志感黑白视觉

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white studio backgrounds with white wood-panel tabletop vignettes, plus occasional deep charcoal #1A1A1A banner sections
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows; raking side light reserved for texture macros
styleLock.surfaceSystem: white round display table, white plank wood floor, light grey stone
styleLock.typography: high-fashion serif display headline with clean geometric sans-serif body; short bilingual headlines only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular badge labels outlined in #111111; translucent black caption chips on dark imagery
styleLock.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle for paired products, centered pairing, generous breathing margins, consistent product scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent black-and-white minimal fashion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white background #FFFFFF, ink black #111111, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one deep crimson accent #8C2F2F; neutral tone; high-fashion serif display headline with clean geometric sans-serif body for short bilingual headlines; seamless white studio backgrounds with white wood-panel tabletop vignettes and occasional deep charcoal banner sections; bright even high-key studio lighting with soft front-left key, soft contact shadows, and raking side light for texture macros; thin-line circular badge labels in #111111; stable paired product presentation with generous breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand logos or watermarks.

shots.intent: 时尚人像与产品双栏构图，一秒建立极简有型的款式调性，承接搜索点击
shots.camera: split layout: left half a generic fashion model cropped above the lips (no recognizable face), right half the {product} pair at a slight front 3/4 angle, eye-level
shots.lighting: bright high-key studio light, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow
shots.background: left half soft grey photo backdrop #D9D9D9, right half white panel #FFFFFF with thin black frame lines #111111
shots.textZone: top-right black-framed headline block; one row of four circular badges below the product
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic hero screen for a fashion footwear detail page. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Split layout: left half a generic fashion model cropped above the lips with hair partially covering the face (no recognizable face), right half {product} as a pair at a slight front 3/4 angle, eye-level, standing on a white panel and filling the right panel at 45-50% of the frame; a thin rectangular frame in #111111 holds the headline. Bright high-key studio light from front-left with soft fill and a soft contact shadow. Top-right a black-framed headline block reads 「{selling_point_1}」 with a short English subtitle and 3 short body lines in #2D2D2D; below the product, one row of four thin-line circular badges with short labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」. Clean magazine-style layout with short readable headlines, no dense body text. Negative: no recognizable face, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled text, no extra props, no dense paragraphs, no cut-off product edges.

shots.intent: 低角度黑底大字主张，把核心卖点压进一秒阅读节奏
shots.camera: photographed from a very low angle looking upward, front 3/4 on the pair
shots.lighting: low-key studio light with a rim accent tracing the silhouette, soft ground shadow
shots.textZone: top center large serif headline; bottom left one small accent tag chip
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero on a deep charcoal panel #1A1A1A. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward, front 3/4, the pair filling 60-70% of the frame and grounded with a soft contact shadow, a subtle rim light tracing the silhouette against the dark background. Top center a large serif headline in #FFFFFF reads 「{selling_point_1}」 with a thin English subtitle line; bottom left one small crimson #8C2F2F tag chip reads 「{callout_1}」. Negative: no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled text, no extra props, no fake discount badges, no invented claims, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 真实街拍语境让买家代入日常穿搭，弱化广告感
shots.camera: eye-level candid at a low three-quarter stance, full body, focus locked on the footwear
shots.lighting: natural afternoon window light from the upper right, 5200K, soft real shadows
shots.background: outdoor cafe terrace with white plank wood floor and glass storefront
shots.props: one rattan chair, one small white bistro table, slightly out of focus
shots.textZone: one small caption chip near the right edge reading 「{callout_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle street-style scene. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A generic person cropped at the shoulders with the face turned away wears slim trousers and {product}, standing mid-step on a white plank wood floor #FFFFFF outside a cafe terrace; eye-level candid camera at a low three-quarter stance, focus locked on the footwear. Natural afternoon light from the upper right, 5200K, soft real shadows consistent with the props. Background: glass storefront and a rattan chair, slightly out of focus. Product pair occupies 25-30% of frame with the street composition breathing naturally around the figure; one small caption chip near the right edge reads 「{callout_1}」. Natural candid look, NOT professional studio photography, NOT retouched. Negative: no recognizable face, no brand logos on clothing or bags, no watermark, no garbled signage, no extra text, no deformed hands, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 侧逆光微距呈现表面纹理与沿边车线，证明用料质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at a high 45-degree angle looking down on the toe box
shots.lighting: raking side light from the left revealing surface grain and edge stitching
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture detail is the whole point
shots.textZone: one small annotation label with a thin leader line
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the upper surface texture along the toe box. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a high 45-degree angle looking down; shallow depth of field f/2.8, foreground sharp. Raking side light from the left reveals the material grain and the fine edge stitching along the sole rim. Soft white background #F7F7F7. Detail occupies 55-60% of frame, the texture filling the shot as the whole point. One small annotation label in #2D2D2D reads 「{callout_1}」 with a thin leader line. Negative: no blurry subject, no fabricated material names, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no duplicated product parts.

shots.intent: 后侧 45° 双靴并排展示弹力侧带与粗跟结构，放大版型稳定性
shots.camera: photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, mid shot, pair side by side
shots.lighting: even high-key studio light from front-top, soft contact shadow
shots.background: white #FFFFFF with faint vertical wood-slat texture
shots.props: one circular inset magnifier highlighting the side gore weave
shots.textZone: left third caption column with one short label
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce structure detail of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Mid shot photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, the pair side by side filling 60-70% of the frame in the right two thirds, with the elastic side gore panel and the block heel as the visual focus. Even high-key studio light from front-top with a soft contact shadow; one small circular inset magnifies the side gore weave. Background white #FFFFFF with a faint vertical wood-slat texture. Left third a clean caption column with one short label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D. Negative: no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled text, no extra props, no warped straight lines, no cut-off heels.

shots.intent: 正上方俯视鞋底纹路，消除耐用与防滑疑虑

shots.lighting: bright even studio light, minimal reflection, soft shadow under the heel
shots.whitespace: minimal even margin around the sole
shots.textZone: one short label beside the sole
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up of {product} showing the outsole. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pair tilts to display the sole tread, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle; the ribbed tread pattern is crisp and sharp. Bright even studio light with minimal reflection and a soft shadow under the heel. Light grey background #EFEFEF. Detail occupies 55-60% of frame with a minimal even margin around the sole. One short label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D sits beside the sole. Negative: no invented grip or wear-resistance data, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no glossy plastic glare, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 白色展台加口红香水瓶比例道具，呈现柔和生活方式化棚拍质感
shots.camera: photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, pair angled front 3/4 on a white round display table
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, gentle highlight on the toe, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one lipstick and one small glass perfume bottle placed to the left as scale anchors, never covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Clean still-life presentation of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Mid shot photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down; the pair stands angled front 3/4 on a white round display table against a white wood-panel wall, the tabletop arrangement filling 60-70% of the frame. Bright even high-key studio light, soft contact shadow, gentle highlight on the toe. Props: one lipstick and one small glass perfume bottle placed to the left as scale anchors, never covering the product. Background white #FFFFFF, tabletop #FAFAFA. shots.intent: 参数表加尺码对照与脚长测量示意，一次性解决选码疑虑
shots.camera: flat infographic layout; product inset at a front 3/4 angle
shots.props: one small line-drawing of a foot with two arrow markers
shots.whitespace: about 15% panel margins around the spec blocks
shots.textZone: left spec list of five short rows; bottom size-chart table; foot diagram label
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size spec infographic on white #FFFFFF. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Structured two-column layout: left column a clean spec list of five short rows with labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」 separated by thin lines in #2D2D2D; right column an inset photo of {product} at a front 3/4 angle occupying 40-45% of the frame; below, a size-chart table of four columns and five rows of short numerals, plus a small line-drawing of a foot with two arrow markers labeled 「{callout_6}」. Even flat lighting, no shadows. The spec blocks keep about 15% panel margins on white. Clean layout with short readable labels, no dense body text. Negative: no fabricated measurements, no dense paragraphs, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled numerals.

shots.intent: 深色工坊横幅加四宫格工艺特写，用可见的制鞋工序细节建立专业信任
shots.camera: top banner from a low angle in a dim workshop; below a four-grid of craft detail photos mixing one overhead, one eye-level and two close-ups
shots.lighting: moody warm workshop light in the banner, even soft light inside the grid cells
shots.background: banner deep charcoal #1A1A1A; grid cells warm brown leather workshop tones
shots.props: leather crafting tools, leather hides, pattern paper
shots.whitespace: about 15% margins between and around the grid cells
shots.textZone: banner centered headline; one short caption chip per grid cell
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen about shoemaking craft. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Top banner: a dim artisan workshop photographed from a low angle, leather tools softly blurred, with a centered white serif headline 「{selling_point_1}」; below, a four-grid of craft detail photos (material selection, pattern cutting, lasting, finishing), each cell carrying a short caption chip 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 in #FFFFFF on translucent black strips. Mixed angles across the grid: one overhead, one eye-level, two close-ups. Moody warm workshop light in the banner, even soft light inside grid cells; banner background deep charcoal #1A1A1A. The four-grid fills the lower part of the frame with thin even gutters, craft scenes occupying 40-50% overall and the grid cells keeping about 15% margins between and around them. Captions stay limited to verifiable craft steps; do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, or test data. Negative: no fake certificates, no brand logos, no watermark, no garbled text, no deformed hands, no recognizable faces.

shots.intent: 整套穿搭平铺收口，以实色行动按钮收束视线促成加购决策

shots.lighting: bright even high-key light, soft real shadows, no glare
shots.background: white #FFFFFF with a thin black frame
shots.props: one knit dress, one silk scarf, one wristwatch, one pair of earrings, one clutch bag arranged in a loose grid
shots.textZone: centered serif headline; one small solid crimson CTA button
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce styling flat-lay close. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat-lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle: the {product} pair at the lower right, styled with one knit dress, one silk scarf, one wristwatch, one pair of earrings and one clutch bag arranged in a loose grid filling 60-70% of the frame, all in a coordinated monochrome palette. Bright even high-key light, soft real shadows, no glare. Background white #FFFFFF with a thin black frame. Centered serif headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #111111 and one small solid crimson #8C2F2F CTA button reading 「{callout_1}」. provenance.notes: 源为一张详情页长图的 15 片切片（750x1200，重叠 60px），按屏合并去重提炼为 10 镜。已剥离：源模特身份与机场街拍名人特征（改用 generic person/裁切构图）、道具与服饰上的真实品牌标识、全部源文案（含材质与跟高数值等具体声称，如进口小牛皮/头层猪皮/4.8寸等，统一转为 {selling_point}/{callout} 短句槽位由商家回填，材质以 {product_identity_lock} 注入）。源文件夹名为泛化的「鞋」，与实际判定品类方向一致，L2 依图精化为女鞋。
